lines.text: What is it like, not how!
Many learners say: How is the weather like today?
Better: What is the weather like today?
What! What is your new school like?

data.wrong: How is the weather like today?
data.right: What is the weather like today?
data.memory: What is the weather like today?

native.tip: Türkçede “Hava nasıl?” deriz; “like” varsa İngilizcede “how” değil “what” kullanılır: “What is the weather like today?”
native.caption: “How is the weather like today” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “like” ile soruyorsan “how” değil “what” gelir. Doğrusu “What is the weather like today?” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “What”. “Like” ile “what” gelir. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: With “like,” use “what”: “What is the weather like today?”
en.caption: Do you say “How is the weather like today”? 😅 When the question has “like” in it, we use “what” and not “how” there. The right sentence is “What is the weather like today?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
